sentences.text: Latocamurus was an extinct genus containing only one species of flat-nosed arthrodire placoderm.
Fossils were found in the Gogo Formation in Kimberley, Western Australia, and the genus was described by Long in 1988.
The type species is Latocamurus coulthardi, and the animal belongs to the family Camuropiscidae within the class Placodermi.
This creature lived during the Early Frasnian stage of the Late Devonian period, with fossils spanning from 382.31 to 379 million years ago.
